items.q: But yeah, you had like Bill Bottoms, and the people up in Buffalo -- Ann Montgomery...

ctx.x: Yeah, King Jones was the first MC. As Paul said, he was the MC that they had that would out on the stage and announce with emphasis. Well, I had the pleasure of meeting him, you know.
But yeah, you had like Bill Bottoms, and the people up in Buffalo -- Ann Montgomery...
